name: Model Context Protocol (incl. graph-database MCP servers)
tier_reason: Protocol EOIP exposes via apps/mcp (BL-47); agent-facing security boundary
owner: Model Context Protocol project (open governance via SEPs; Anthropic-originated)
release_cadence: spec revisions a few times per year; SDK releases roughly monthly
license: Spec/SDK licence UNVERIFIED; graph servers: MIT (Neo4j Labs, FalkorDB, Memgraph), Apache-2.0 (awslabs), NOASSERTION (TigerGraph)
redistribution_notes: EOIP ships its own server; do not bundle third-party graph MCP servers. Verify SDK and spec licence before redistribution.
legal_review_reason: TigerGraph MCP licence NOASSERTION; SDK/spec licence not verified
community_vs_enterprise: Neo4j Labs servers are explicitly not supported by the Neo4j product team; no SLA
resolution_note: Memgraph MCP is integrations/mcp-memgraph in memgraph/ai-toolkit; Neo4j Labs project distinct from any official product server (not examined); no HugeGraph/JanusGraph/Stardog/GraphDB MCP servers found
action_reason: Assigned Tier A; EOIP gap analysis completed
decision_summary: REUSE protocol; BUILD OAuth resource-server mode, tool annotations, ACL filtering; EXPERIMENT tool-manifest pinning and SDK v2 migration

name: Ollama
tier_reason: Local model runtime already in EOIP compose (pinned 0.12.3); default-local LLM/embedding path
license: MIT (repository); models carry their own licences
redistribution_notes: Runtime MIT is redistributable; model weights are subject to per-model licences, so ship no weights by default and keep a model-licence register.
legal_review_reason: Model-licence pass-through for any bundled or recommended weights
community_vs_enterprise: Cloud models and web search are account-based optional features; disable with OLLAMA_NO_CLOUD
resolution_note: EOIP pin 0.12.3 published 2025-09-26; CVE-2026-103663 affects 0.34.2 to <0.35.0 (OpenCVE); whether 0.12.3 is affected by other 2026 CVEs is unverified
decision_summary: INTEGRATE as default one-node provider behind provider abstraction; BUILD egress sidecar, offline model bundle and model-licence register; update pin

name: Qdrant
tier_reason: Leading dedicated vector engine; candidate for the multiple-vector-store requirement (BL-14, ADR-005)
redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0 permits OEM redistribution; trademark use for white-label needs review.
community_vs_enterprise: Managed cloud offerings exist; enterprise-only feature gating NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED in this pass
decision_summary: INTEGRATE as optional VectorIndex backend; BUILD mandatory ACL/tenant filter wrapper plus graph recheck; DEFER snapshots until verified

name: pgvector
tier_reason: Vector search inside PostgreSQL; only candidate with native row-level security and ACID on vector rows
release_cadence: tag releases every few weeks; tags only, no GitHub Releases
redistribution_notes: Permissive; adds PostgreSQL dependency, which EOIP compose does not currently run.
community_vs_enterprise: Single community edition; managed Postgres providers differ in availability
decision_summary: INTEGRATE as VectorIndex backend; EXPERIMENT RLS-backed ACL enforcement and tenant partitioning; verify RLS and ANN planner interaction

name: OpenSearch (k-NN, full-text)
tier_reason: Full-text, ANN, hybrid and a built-in document-level security layer; directly relevant to BL-18
release_cadence: 3.x minor about every 8 weeks; 2.19 patch releases
license: Apache-2.0 (core); per-plugin licences not individually verified
redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0 permits redistribution; verify each bundled plugin and trademark rules for white-label.
community_vs_enterprise: Single open-source distribution; managed services by vendors not examined
resolution_note: Not Elasticsearch (separate C10 Tier B entry). DLS interaction with k-NN is NOT PUBLICLY VERIFIED
decision_summary: INTEGRATE as optional enterprise-search backend with DLS as defence in depth; EXPERIMENT DLS x ANN recall; DEFER as single-node default (JVM weight)
